basics.name: Tahmidul Bin Ferdous
basics.summary: Currently employed at International Islamic University Chittagong. CSE graduate working on whether machine learning evaluations measure what they claim to measure.

portfolio.name: Data Leakage Audit of a Lung Cancer CT Benchmark
portfolio.description: A controlled paired audit of four deep learning architecture families on the IQ-OTH/NCCD benchmark.

portfolio.name: Rectified Flow for Conditional CT Synthesis
portfolio.description: Class-conditional flow matching from scratch; DDP on 2× T4, ported to JAX on 8× TPU v5e.

portfolio.name: BanglaPoemGPT — a GPT built from scratch
portfolio.description: ~10M-parameter autoregressive decoder transformer trained from first principles for Bengali poetry.

portfolio.name: DSMaT — depthwise Mamba-attention transformer
portfolio.description: Original hybrid architecture combining depthwise convolutions, Mamba state-space blocks, and self-attention.

portfolio.name: ID Card Wearing Detection
portfolio.description: Real-time compliance monitoring on a self-collected and self-annotated campus dataset (mAP50 = 0.82).

portfolio.name: Facial Attendance System
portfolio.description: Edge facial verification using SSD detection and FaceNet embeddings tuned for mobile deployment.

portfolio.name: Face Mouse for Accessibility
portfolio.description: Hands-free cursor control; nose-position tracking drives the pointer, eye blinks trigger clicks.

portfolio.name: Generative models from scratch
portfolio.description: DCGAN for Bengali digits and WGAN-GP on face data with exact gradient-penalty loops.

portfolio.name: Sketch AI: Real-Time Air Canvas
portfolio.description: Real-time air canvas: webcam fingertip tracking draws on screen with hand gestures.
